name: Hi! I am Shivendra Singh 👋
title: Software Engineer & AI Engineer
tagline: Full-Stack Web Development | AI Systems | ML | MERN | C++ DSA | JavaScript | Python | FastAPI
about: I am an undergraduate student pursuing a B.Tech in Electronics and Communication Engineering at IIITDM Jabalpur, dedicated to building scalable software systems and intelligent AI applications. I have a strong foundation in Data Structures and Algorithms in C++, actively practicing competitive programming to solve complex computational problems. My technical expertise spans modern full-stack development using React, Next.js, Node.js, Express, Flask, and FastAPI, combined with backend databases and cloud architecture. I am passionate about autonomous AI agents, intelligent revenue & automation systems, and high-performance software engineering, continuously building impactful real-world applications.

projects.title: RazorGrow — Autonomous Merchant Growth Agent
